content: Lenis ships a React subpath export lenis/react (ReactLenis component, useLenis hook) inside the single 'lenis' npm package - no separate react-lenis package needed. Sync with GSAP via lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update) and add lenis.raf (ms) to gsap.ticker.add, disable Lenis's own rAF loop (autoRaf:false) to avoid dual rAF loops.
